name: Sprocket
text:
Decision: We should build a lightweight “prompt health dashboard” that surfaces real-time stats on prompt performance (error rates, latency, user drop-off points) and flags anomalies—so we can spot weak prompts or routing glitches before they hurt users.

Why: Right now we’re flying blind; a dashboard turns vague hunches into clear decisions. It’s cheap to wire up existing telemetry and gives us a single place to see what’s actually happening, not what we *think* is happening. The trade-off is extra UI work, but that’s a one-time cost compared to the ongoing pain of reactive fixes.
